landing.heroTitle: Know what to grow, before you sow
landing.heroSubtitle: AgriGuru AI studies your soil and weather values and suggests crops that match them. Free, simple, and in your own language.
landing.step1Title: Enter your soil and weather values
landing.step1Body: Nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, temperature, humidity, pH and rainfall.
landing.step2Body: A trained model compares your values against 22 crops and ranks the closest matches.
landing.step3Body: Every recommendation is saved so you can look back at what you entered and when.
landing.honestyTitle: What AgriGuru is, and is not
landing.honestyBody: AgriGuru suggests crops by matching the numbers you enter against patterns in an agricultural dataset. It does not know your field's history, your irrigation, your market, or this season's forecast. Treat it as a starting point for a conversation with an agricultural officer — not as a replacement for one.

crop.title: Crop Recommendation
crop.subtitle: Enter your soil test and weather values. Every field is required.
crop.nitrogenHelp: Nitrogen level from your soil test
crop.phosphorusHelp: Phosphorus level from your soil test
crop.potassiumHelp: Potassium level from your soil test
crop.temperatureHelp: Typical temperature in your area during the growing season
crop.humidityHelp: Typical relative humidity in your area
crop.phHelp: Soil acidity from your soil test. 7 is neutral.
crop.rainfallHelp: Expected rainfall over the growing season
crop.npkUnitWarningTitle: About the N, P and K values
crop.npkUnitWarningBody: These are ratio values as used in the training dataset. They are NOT kilograms per hectare. If your soil health card reports kg/ha, those numbers are on a different scale and will give a misleading result.
crop.noFarm: Do not link to a farm

result.title: Recommended crop
result.confidenceHigh: The model matched your values closely.
result.confidenceMedium: The model found a reasonable match, but other crops were close.
result.confidenceLow: The model was unsure. Treat this as one option among several.
result.noAlternatives: No other crop came close for these values.
result.whyBody: You entered nitrogen {nitrogen}, phosphorus {phosphorus}, potassium {potassium}, temperature {temperature}°C, humidity {humidity}%, pH {ph} and rainfall {rainfall}mm. The trained model compared these against patterns for 22 crops and ranked {crop} as the closest match.
result.outOfRangeTitle: Some values are outside what the model has seen
result.outOfRangeBody: These values fall outside the range in the training data: {fields}. The model is extrapolating, so this result is less reliable than usual.
result.disclaimerBody: This is a data-driven suggestion based only on the seven values you entered. It does not account for your field history, irrigation, seed availability, market prices or this season's forecast. Confirm with your local agriculture officer before sowing.
